request.description: Whether to launch a new Flutter/Dart application or attach to a running VM Service.

program.description: Path to the Dart entry point or test file (e.g. lib/main.dart, test/widget_test.dart, or $ZED_RELATIVE_FILE).

isTest.description: Force running the Flutter/Dart debug adapter in --test mode for breakpoint debugging of unit, widget, or integration tests. Auto-detected for *_test.dart and test/ paths.

cwd.description: Working directory of the Flutter or Dart project containing pubspec.yaml (Monorepo subpackages are auto-resolved from program).

deviceId.description: Target Flutter device ID (e.g. macos, chrome, emulator-5554). If omitted, uses the device selected via `flutter-debugger-server ctl select-device`.

flutterMode.description: Flutter build mode. Hot Reload and Service Extensions are available in debug mode.

flavor.description: Build flavor name passed to Flutter via --flavor.

dartDefineFromFile.description: Path to a JSON or .env file passed via --dart-define-from-file.

args.description: Runtime arguments passed to the application.

toolArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the flutter or dart CLI tool (e.g. --dart-define=ENV=dev).

vmServiceUri.description: VM Service URI when attaching to an already running Flutter/Dart application.

env.description: Environment variables applied when launching the Flutter/Dart process.

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Whether to allow stepping into external pub package libraries.

debugSdkLibraries.description: Whether to allow stepping into Dart/Flutter SDK libraries.

evaluateGettersInDebugViews.description: Whether to evaluate getters in debug variable views.

evaluateToStringInDebugViews.description: Whether to invoke toString() on objects in debug variable views.
